title: Phase 5 Final Operation Signoff Package
description: Machine-testable final signoff package for the local mock AI training platform delivery. It aggregates local docs, static previews, generated evidence, and allowlisted validation commands without starting real providers, agents, MCP servers, cloud resources, sandboxes, or publish actions.
